# National League Official Academies
> A youth soccer league in the United States for the official academies of Liga MX and MLS clubs, run in partnership with Wame Sports.
## Facts
- Categories: U17, U15, U13, U11 (Sub 17, Sub 15, Sub 13, Sub 11)
- Season start: February 2027
- Website: https://nationalleagueusa.com/
- Languages: English (default) and Spanish (https://nationalleagueusa.com/es/)
## How to join
- Teams/academies and players register with the forms on the Join page (a parent or guardian registers minors): https://nationalleagueusa.com/join.html
- Questions: the message form on the Contact page, https://nationalleagueusa.com/contact.html
## Technology partner
Wame Sports provides analytics tools, match video, and player profiles for the league. Details: https://nationalleagueusa.com/wame.html
## Contact
info@nationalleagueusa.com
